assertion_audit.tests/test_a_live_pointer_carries_no_clo: Fails if the promotion stops recording the detector's report on the returned row; both sides read the monkeypatched detector's list against the promotion's own record.

Fails if any live-pointer write keeps clone_matches; logs/negative-control-base.log records this assertion red at 6686bb507f ('the live pointer carries the promotion's clone report'), so restoring the base runs.py:497 reddens it.
Fails if the field is lost from the committed ledger; the row is re-read through ledger.load rather than taken from the receipt the promotion returned.
Fails if _pointer_text hands the decoder the whole file; the base control records 'the listing parsed 8320157 bytes for this pointer', so reverting runs.py:1236's reduced text reddens it.
Fails if list_live returns the key; the base control shows the key returned at 6686bb507f.
Moves with its input: len(report) is read from the ledger row the test itself passes to _clone_week_cells, so no pointer-side regression reddens it.
Fails if the promotion receipt and the committed ledger row disagree on the report; both sides are reads of stored state rather than fixture values.

assertion_independence: The durable assertions are independent: line 186 re-reads the committed ledger through ledger.load and line 229 counts bytes through a recording stand-in whose positive control at line 231 proves the instrument decodes the whole file before the listing's own figure is believed. One assertion is not independent -- line 253 compares velocity's count against the length of the same row the test handed velocity -- and it is recorded as a non-blocking finding.
evidence_caveats: logs/baseline-suite.log and logs/after-suite.log carry revision, host, tree, module.__file__ and the literal command, but no partition field, so 'all_debug' is the manifest's statement rather than a receipt visible in the log.

The fragment's arm paragraph names head revision 5b15fe3f3a while logs/after-suite.log opens '# revision: 7ca7a5a6e8'; the two shas differ only by the fragment commit, so the 61-passed figure stands but the cited sha has no log.
The done_when's importing-test clause is narrower than the change: 935 files under tests/ reference reckon.crew.runs and the arms run two of them.
The gate log's summary line is the figure the record quotes; the pre-change 8,320,157-byte figure comes from the negative control's failure message, not from a separate measurement log.
